title: "re-raise every x minutes if unacknowledged" in alert is not working properly
symptom: Alerts using a 5-minute 're-raise' time are triggered after 1 minute regardless of the set value. The issue occurs when using the ascending volume profile.
cause: The 're-raise every x minutes if unacknowledged' feature does not work with the ascending volume profile, because the ascending profile is designed to increase alert strength every minute.
fix: The issue is not a bug but a design conflict. To avoid the behavior, use a non-ascending sound profile. Alternatively, a feature request could be made to allow configuring the rate of volume increase, but this is not currently implemented.
evidence_quote: This feature is not working with ascending profile, since ascending profile means that the alert will get stronger every minute.
